songs.title: King of Rivals
songs.description: Learn the two little tunes, then play them together.

sections.title: The first little tune
sections.instruction: Place your right thumb (finger 1) on A, above middle C.

sections.title: The second little tune
sections.instruction: Move your right thumb (finger 1) to E, just above middle C.

songs.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
songs.description: A familiar melody using just three fingers.

sections.title: The melody
sections.instruction: Place your right thumb (finger 1) on middle C. Keep one finger on each neighbouring white key.

songs.title: Ode to Joy
songs.description: A short, simplified version of Beethoven's famous melody.

sections.title: The opening melody
sections.instruction: Place your right thumb (finger 1) on middle C. Each finger stays on its own white key.
